status: shadow versions: recorded and evaluated in parallel with forward-rule-v1, which they do not change; parameters frozen; any change requires a new version

versions.name: V1-四分之一
versions.definition: forward-rule-v1 L2, and the T-10 line is a quarter line (|line| mod 1 is 0.25 or 0.75), i.e. the rule team is the .25 receiving team or the .75 giving team
versions.origin: research/README.md section on further improvements; proposed after the 10-09..10-12 review

versions.name: V1-多阶段
versions.definition: rule team on a quarter line; G_LINE; at least two of V1 at T-120, T-60 and T-30 point to the rule team; none of V1 at T-120, T-60, T-30 and T-10 points to the other team
versions.stageTeam: each stage uses its own cutoff (kickoff minus the stage lead) and its own line: D > 50 is the giving team at that line, D < 50 the other team; neutral or unavailable counts as no direction
versions.origin: research/improve.py multi-stage vote, selected while exploring

evaluation.decisionsCounted: non-late decisions with kickoff at or after prospectiveFrom; the same frozen T-10 quote and settlement as forward-rule-v1
evaluation.comparison: each shadow against forward-rule-v1 L2 and L0 on the same decisions (same period)
evaluation.winRate: (win + half_win) / (win + half_win + half_loss + loss); push excluded
